items.exampleEn: The children watched a magic show.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們看了一場魔術表演。

items.exampleEn: Walking to school takes me ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 我走路上學要花十分鐘。

items.exampleEn: She played a happy tune on the piano.
items.exampleZh: 她在鋼琴上彈了一首歡樂的曲子。

items.exampleEn: My sister wants to be a dancer.
Thank you for helping me. You're an angel!
items.exampleZh: 謝謝你幫我，你真是個天使！

items.exampleEn: This movie is a sweet romance.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影是一個甜蜜的愛情故事。

items.exampleEn: A mysterious letter came for you today.
items.exampleZh: 今天有一封神秘的信寄給你。

items.sentenceEn: I can't remember the tune of that song.
items.sentenceZh: 我想不起那首歌的旋律。

items.audioEn: The magic show starts at seven, and the dancers come on at eight.
items.audioZh: 魔術表演七點開始，舞者八點出場。

items.sentenceEn: Walking along the beach helps me relax.
items.sentenceZh: 沿著海邊散步能讓我放鬆。

items.sentenceEn: The old house looks dark and mysterious.
items.sentenceZh: 那棟老房子看起來又暗又神秘。

items.stemEn: The ____ danced on the stage for an hour.
items.stemZh: 那位舞者在舞台上跳了一個小時。

items.stemEn: Nobody knows who he is. He is a ____ man.
items.stemZh: 沒有人知道他是誰，他是個神秘的男人。

items.passageEn: Every Friday night, Ben goes to a small theater. Last week, there was a magic show by a mysterious man in a black hat. Then three dancers danced to a happy tune. The show ended with a short romance about an angel and a farmer. After the show, Ben walked home along the river.
items.passageZh: 每週五晚上，Ben 都會去一間小劇場。上週有一場魔術表演，表演者是一位戴黑帽的神秘男子。接著三位舞者隨著歡樂的曲子跳舞。表演最後是一齣天使和農夫的愛情短劇。散場後，Ben 沿著河邊走路回家。

questions.questionZh: 魔術表演的表演者是誰？
options: 一位戴黑帽的神秘男子
一場魔術和三位舞者的表演
天使和農夫的愛情短劇

referenceEn: She is a very good dancer.

items.instructionZh: 用 walking 造一個句子，說說你什麼時候或在哪裡散步。
referenceEn: I go walking in the park after dinner.
Walking with my dog is the best part of my day.
rubricZh: walking 當名詞表示「散步」（例如 go walking、Walking is…）
walking 當主詞時，動詞用單數（例如 Walking is）
